concepts.gloss_en: the joining/union of chasadim and gevurot (the act of connecting them, = peace/shalom)
chasadim and gevurot themselves (the paired divine attributes)

notes: Rule 4: the union/joining of X is not X. 'התחברות חסדים וגבורות' is the act of connecting the two (identified with shalom, uniting chochmah/mochin=chasadim with dibbur=gevurot), whereas 'חסדים וגבורות' names the attributes themselves (here describing kiddush Hashem's two phases). Same Torah (lm1:80) but distinct referents — kept separate.
